behaviors.behavior: Event folders live at .shipwright/events/{drops,archive,quarantine}; every writer/reader/fold/adopt/grade path uses the one definition
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_events_folder_move.py::test_new_constants_live_under_shipwright_events and the re-run event suites on the new paths PASSED

behaviors.behavior: A repo with an old root event folder is hard-refused by writers (library and real record_event CLI) and release evidence, with the exact fix and a tool path that exists
A reader never takes an old root folder for no events (absence gates fail closed); archive kind is detected under relative and absolute roots
Symlinks and junk: nested symlink hides the folder, OS-junk-only or symlinked old folder is not an old folder
Migration tool moves tracked (git mv) and untracked (staged) files, never overwrites or nests, drops junk, refuses collisions/sub-directories, converges on rerun
gitignore canon and self-heal re-include the parent chain, and write nothing where it cannot work
Integrity check accepts exactly the byte-identical move and flags deletion, new file at old name, move+edit, cross-kind, rename, nested path
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_events_folder_move_migrate.py::test_integrity_accepts_the_byte_identical_move and the five negative integrity tests PASSED

behaviors.behavior: F11 committed-event check: a drop committed inside an ignored folder passes, an uncommitted one fails with the hint
Rollback rehearsal on a copy of the real history works on the new folders (emergency and full fold stage deletions)
